organizer: SPIE (the international society for optics and photonics); run as a symposium of 9-11 parallel conferences, each publishing its own Proceedings of SPIE volume
fields: smart structures, adaptive and multifunctional materials
electroactive polymer actuators and sensors (artificial muscles)
soft mechatronics, soft robotics and wearable/implantable systems
structural health monitoring (SHM) and nondestructive evaluation (NDE)
sensors and smart structures for civil, mechanical and aerospace systems
metamaterials, vibration control and energy harvesting
digital twins and AI for NDE/SHM
typical_month: March (2020 was planned for late April and replaced by an online Digital Forum)

submission.type: Abstract (200-300 words) submitted to one of the symposium conferences and reviewed by its chairs; accepted authors submit a manuscript for the Proceedings of SPIE (SPIE Digital Library)
submission.typical_abstract_deadline: Late August to mid-September of the year before the meeting (about 6-7 months ahead); SPIE often extends the deadline or keeps accepting late/post-deadline abstracts
submission.typical_final_deadline: Manuscripts due about 2-4 weeks before the meeting (2027: 3 Mar 2027; 2026: 25 Feb 2026; 2025: 26 Feb 2025)
submission.notes: abstract_deadline fields hold the main abstract deadline including official extensions; post-deadline/late submission windows (which SPIE runs almost every year, subject to chair approval) are excluded. 2027: abstracts due 30 Sep 2026 (official page lists it with 'Late submissions still being accepted'), author notification 7 Dec 2026, manuscripts due 3 Mar 2027. 2025: deadline 11 Sep 2024, extended to 30 Sep 2024. 2018: deadline 21 Aug 2017, post-deadline submissions accepted through 15 Sep 2017. 2023: post-deadline abstracts accepted until 23 Jan 2023.

next_edition.notes: Official SPIE pages (read 2026-11-03; Wayback capture 2026-11-01 of the event home page) give 22-25 March 2027, Vancouver, BC, Canada, and 'Abstract submission deadline is 30 September 2026. Post-deadline submissions may still be considered.' Author notification 7 Dec 2026; manuscripts due 3 Mar 2027. Venue not stated on the pages that could be read (third-party listings give the Sheraton Vancouver Wall Centre, the 2025-2026 venue). Whether 30 Sep 2026 was itself an extension of an earlier date could not be checked (no earlier 2026 capture of the guidelines page).

editions.venue: Town & Country Resort and Convention Center
editions.notes: Official call for papers and final technical program (archived). Deadline is the CFP date; whether it was later extended was not checked (no archived event page from Aug-Sep 2014 was found).

editions.notes: Official call for papers and final technical program (archived). Deadline is the CFP date; extension not checked.

Official event page (archived Aug-Sep 2016) lists 'Abstract Deadline 12 September 2016', author notification 21 Nov 2016; by Oct 2016 the deadline line read 'Submit Your Abstract Now' (post-deadline window). Technical conferences began on 26 March.

editions.notes: Call for papers: abstracts due 21 Aug 2017. The event page (Sep 2017) adds 'Post-deadline submissions accepted through 15 September' (excluded, not an extension).

editions.venue: Embassy Suites by Hilton Denver Downtown Convention Center
editions.notes: Official event page (Aug 2018): abstracts due 22 Aug 2018, author notification 29 Oct 2018. By Sep 2018 the page showed 'Submit Your Abstract Now' (post-deadline window), with no extended date.

editions.venue: Virtual Digital Forum (originally planned for 26-30 April 2020 at the Anaheim Marriott, Anaheim, California)
editions.notes: The in-person meeting in Anaheim was cancelled due to COVID-19 and replaced by a free online Digital Forum (pre-recorded presentations available 27 April - 8 May 2020). Abstract deadline 16 Oct 2019 per the event page (shown from June 2019 onward), author notification 20 Dec 2019.

editions.venue: Virtual Digital Forum (originally planned for 7-11 March 2021 at the Hilton Long Beach, California)
editions.notes: Held online only as a Digital Forum on 22-26 March 2021 (the Jan 2021 page still showed 7-10 March). Abstract deadline 26 Aug 2020 per the event page (Jun-Aug 2020); by Dec 2020 the page listed only post-deadline submissions.
Event page (Sep 2021): 'Abstracts are due 25 August 2021'. Post-deadline abstracts were accepted through 10 Jan 2022 (excluded). The Hilton Long Beach is named as the conference hotel.

Call for papers and abstract guidelines: abstracts due 14 Sep 2022; post-deadline abstracts due 23 Jan 2023 (excluded). No extension wording found in the Sep 2022 event-page capture. The Hilton Long Beach is named as the conference hotel.

Abstract guidelines (May 2023): abstracts due 13 Sep 2023, author notification 4 Dec 2023, manuscripts due 6 Mar 2024. No Sep-Nov 2023 capture exists, so a possible extension could not be checked. Hotel page lists the Hilton Long Beach.

Original deadline 11 Sep 2024. The event home page (27 Sep 2024) states 'The submission deadline has been extended to 30 September'; the guidelines page words it as 'Late submissions now accepted until 30 September 2024'. Treated as an official extension. The Sheraton Vancouver Wall Centre is named as the conference hotel.

Call for papers and abstract guidelines: abstracts due 10 Sep 2025, author notification 24 Nov 2025, manuscripts due 25 Feb 2026. No Sep-Oct 2025 capture of the event or guidelines page with deadline text was found, so a possible extension could not be checked. Event page (Mar 2026): 'The Sheraton Vancouver Wall Centre ... is the home of Smart Structures + Nondestructive Evaluation 2026.' Crossref proceedings metadata gives 16-20 March (on-demand period included).

Official pages read 2026-11-03: 'Abstracts due - Late submissions still being accepted: 30 September 2026'; author notification 7 Dec 2026; manuscripts due 3 Mar 2027. Venue not confirmed on an official page that could be read (third-party listings give the Sheraton Vancouver Wall Centre). Eleven conferences announced, including two new ones (Metamaterials, Metasurfaces, and Metastructures; A Tribute Conference Honoring Daniel Inman).

notes: spie.org and the SPIE Digital Library sit behind a bot check, so most values come from Wayback Machine copies of official spie.org pages and call-for-papers/program PDFs; the 2027 pages were read live on 2026-11-03. Proceedings metadata deposited by SPIE at Crossref (event name, location, dates per volume) was used as a cross-check for every year 2015-2026; its end dates sometimes include on-demand access periods (e.g. 2022 to 11 Apr, 2023 to 17 Mar), so official event-page dates are used. Dates are the full symposium span shown by SPIE (conferences plus courses). SPIE runs post-deadline/late abstract windows almost every year; those are excluded. Unverified: whether the 2015, 2016, 2024 and 2026 deadlines were extended (no captures from the deadline period), and the 2027 venue. Venues for 2022-2026 are the hotels SPIE names as the conference hotel / home of the meeting.
